hypothesis: Root cause: a poison pill on partition 1 that order-sync cannot deserialize. Fix: move partition 1 past the record; alternatively the consumer has a deserializer bug.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis names a poison pill on partition 1 that cannot be deserialized, which matches the ground truth. It hedges with "the consumer has a deserializer bug" as an alternative, though. That hedge leaves the root-cause layer ambiguous between kafka (the bad record) and consumer (a code bug), so it is not committed to the kafka layer.
